prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep them exactly as photographed: the same face, hair or fur, skin tone and build, now in a towering white powdered wig and a shimmering silver ball gown with puffed sleeves. A grand palace garden with clipped cone-shaped hedges and a gravel path at golden hour. (1) They pedal an antique penny-farthing bicycle hard down the gravel path straight toward the camera, gown billowing, face dead serious; (2) behind them a golden carriage pulled by a fluffy white poodle bursts into view and closes in between the hedges, and the camera swings to the poodle galloping; (3) they stand up on the pedals, pull away down the path and vanish in a cloud of dust with the carriage still chasing. Low tracking camera moving with the rider, one continuous take, vertical 9:16. Upbeat electronic ring-ding synth beat in the audio, no vocals. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
